India and Canada back CEPA talks

articles.headline: India Joins Global Rate-Tightening Wave With First Hike
articles.whyItMatters: Higher borrowing costs will impact consumer EMIs and economic growth.
articles.brief: The Reserve Bank of India raised the repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.5% amid rising inflation pressures, marking its first hike in nearly four years and increasing loan costs.

articles.headline: Trump Administration Proposes Massive $70,000 OPT Fee
articles.whyItMatters: The steep cost threatens international student work opportunities in the US.
articles.brief: The Trump administration has proposed charging international students holding F-1 visas $70,000 for on-the-job training through Optional Practical Training to curb fraud.

articles.headline: India and Canada Advance Comprehensive Economic Partnership
articles.whyItMatters: Bilateral trade aims to hit CAD 70 billion by 2030.
articles.brief: Ahead of a planned prime ministerial visit, India and Canada are progressing through talks for a Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement to boost economic ties.

articles.headline: Scientists Create World's First Nuclear Clocks
articles.whyItMatters: Nuclear clocks offer unprecedented precision compared to atomic clocks.
articles.brief: Researchers in Vienna and Beijing have successfully developed the world's first nuclear clocks, a breakthrough that could revolutionize navigation, telecommunications, and fundamental physics research.

articles.headline: Google Ordered to Suspend Finnish Data Center Work
articles.whyItMatters: Environmental compliance halts major tech infrastructure projects.
articles.brief: The Finnish Licensing and Supervision Agency ordered Google to halt construction on data center projects in Muhos and Kajaani until environmental impact assessments are satisfied.

articles.headline: India-Bound Sunflower Oil Cargoes Face Disruptions
articles.whyItMatters: Supply chain shocks threaten commodity availability and pricing.
articles.brief: India-bound sunflower oil shipments are confronting cancellations and severe delays as the ongoing war severely disrupts maritime and overland Russian export routes.

articles.headline: Federal Reserve Minutes Reveal Internal Policy Divisions
articles.whyItMatters: Uncertainty over monetary easing influences global financial markets.
articles.brief: Newly released Federal Reserve minutes show policymakers were deeply divided over the logic behind recent rate-hike decisions, reflecting ongoing ambiguity in future US monetary policy paths.

articles.headline: Opposition Protests Escalates Against Election Commission
articles.whyItMatters: Political friction heightens tensions ahead of upcoming state actions.
articles.brief: Opposition INDIA bloc members attempted high-profile protests in Delhi demanding the resignation of the Chief Election Commissioner, leading to brief detentions and political standoffs.

articles.headline: Medical Trips Found Costliest Across Rural and Urban India
articles.whyItMatters: Out-of-pocket health expenses place massive financial burdens on households.
articles.brief: A comprehensive spending study reveals that health and medical journeys incur the highest per-capita expenses across both rural and urban Indian landscapes over a one-year cycle.

articles.headline: Stiff Penalties and Safety Probes Follow Mid-Air Incident
articles.whyItMatters: Aviation security faces renewed scrutiny over cockpit vulnerabilities.
articles.brief: Following recent violent cockpit breaches, regional aviation authorities have initiated sweeping safety probes to evaluate severe security risks across commercial flight paths.

articles.headline: Escalating Security Threats Drive Up Strait of Hormuz Risk Pay
articles.whyItMatters: Geopolitical maritime choke points jeopardize international oil trade.
articles.brief: Oil tanker captains are being offered hazard bonuses exceeding $100,000 to navigate the high-risk Strait of Hormuz amid escalating regional security threats and attacks.

articles.headline: Tennis Stars Return to Action in Domestic League Circuits
articles.whyItMatters: Top-tier athletic events boost domestic sports engagement.
articles.brief: Veteran tennis players like Rohan Bopanna prepare for competitive action, lining up to represent regional franchises in upcoming professional league tournaments.

articles.headline: Fenesta Open Tennis Championship Reaches Quarterfinal Stages
articles.whyItMatters: Youth talent rises as top seeds battle for championship spots.
articles.brief: The Fenesta Open saw dramatic upsets in early rounds as rising contenders advanced into the highly anticipated singles quarterfinals across various categories.

articles.headline: Conservation Success Stories Bring Hope for Indian Wildlife
articles.whyItMatters: Targeted conservation science prevents endangered species from extinction.
articles.brief: Recent field metrics on India's endangered species demonstrate encouraging rebounds, underscoring the vital impact of sustained conservation biology and local action.

articles.headline: Multi-Storey Building Collapse in Delhi Triggers Rescue Ops
articles.whyItMatters: Urban safety standards remain under scrutiny following fatal structural failures.
articles.brief: A residential building collapse in East Delhi's Seemapuri left three people dead and several others injured, prompting emergency rescue operations and official probes.

articles.headline: Lightning Strike Damages IndiGo Flight Mid-Air
articles.whyItMatters: Severe weather hazards test aviation resilience and emergency responses.
articles.brief: An IndiGo flight carrying 110 passengers was struck by lightning at 17,000 feet, resulting in nose damage before landing safely at Lucknow airport with no injuries.
